LanguageData.EI_CentralHearth.label: central hearth
LanguageData.EI_CentralHearth.description: A stone-lined hearth for warmth, light, and simple cooking. It burns wood continuously and cooks more slowly than a stove. Its bills include smoked meat for storage and, after Brewing research, oat wort from raw oats and hops. Hearthside seating can provide 20% faster Social recreation while it burns.
